Eli (Partnerships): Heads-up: I'm drafting a one-page partner SEV play that covers marketplace listings, hardware field failures, and SI-managed deployments. Need a single canonical flow + fallbacks. Quick thoughts? :mag:

Hannah (HW Eng): For colo hardware incidents we cant rely on Slack. We use three parallel paths: 1) channel buttons (if available), 2) email with strict subject format, 3) phone pager. Phone path must require serial+site in the confirm step.

Priya (SI Programs): SIs often block external Slack. We need an email-only template that auto-creates a bridge. Proposal SUBJECT: [PSEV] Partner=<PartnerName> Cust=<Customer> Impact=<short>. Reply should include a bridge link generated by our parser.

Jon (Support Escalations): Love the email template. Add a rule: if email contains `FW=panic` or `hw_serial=`, auto-escalate to hw-liaison. Also: pin a tiny escalation matrix in channel describing who to page for SEV1 vs SEV2.

Rae (SRE): Implementation notes: bridge-creation API should accept metadata: listing_id, partner_tier, hw_serial, site_region, si_ticket. Also include initiator_type=(partner|internal|si) and correlation_id for telemetry.

Eli (Partnerships): What about partners that have limited Slack buttons? Reaction-based fallback? Eg :rotating_light: on the triage message creates a bridge. Also a slash fallback `/partner-sev` for automation.

Hannah (HW Eng): Yes to reaction fallback but require DM verification before phone page. Prevent accidental red_circles triggering pager. Two-step confirm for phone.

Priya (SI Programs): Can we standardize the one-pager wording for partners? Minimal: how to trigger SEV, what fields we need, what to expect (who will be paged), and joint-announcement process. I can write that.

ops-bot: automation-check: channel #partners-voltix allowed. reaction-trigger enabled. email-parser webhook reachable: https://hooks.redwood.example/sev-email.

Jon (Support Escalations): Joint announcements: add a checkbox when creating the bridge: "partner-visible". If checked, DM marketing@redwood and legal@redwood with the incident stub and add tag `partner-visible`. Also freeze outbound statements until comms triage.

Rae (SRE): Add runbook pointer in every bridge: runbook://partner/marketplace or runbook://partner/hw or runbook://partner/si. Bridge API should return a short runbook link in the create response so responders have direct context.

Eli (Partnerships): Draft pinned message for channels (short):

Eli (Partnerships): """
Partner SEV cheat sheet:
• Preferred: use the channel buttons to start a War Room
• If Slack blocked: email partner-sev@redwood.example with SUBJECT: [PSEV] Partner=<Partner> Cust=<Customer> Impact=<one-liner>
• If systems are unreachable: call partner phone oncall +1-555-0189 (confirm hw_serial/site before paging)
• Reactions: add :rotating_light: to the triage msg to trigger fallback (will prompt verification)
• Severity routing: SEV1 -> page SRE + Support Escalations + Partner Oncall; SEV2 -> Support Lead + Partner Liaison; SEV3 -> async triage
• Mark "partner-visible" when the incident may be public to notify Comms & Legal
"""

Priya (SI Programs): Include a short consent line about sharing logs: "Please confirm customer consent when attaching logs for partner troubleshooting" and link to policy: https://policies.redwood.example/data-sharing.

Hannah (HW Eng): And add: "If firmware suspect: attach hw_serial and fw_version in initial message".

Jon (Support Escalations): Action items: Eli to publish pinned cheat sheet + one-pager (owner: Eli). Rae to add metadata fields to bridge API and ensure runbook links (owner: Rae). Hannah to provide phone oncall list and phone confirmation flow (owner: Hannah). Priya to draft SI email subject template and consent blurb (owner: Priya). I'll update the escalation matrix and add the reaction/slash handling docs (owner: Jon).

Eli (Partnerships): Scheduling a short walkthrough next Wed 11am PT to align HW, SI, Support, SRE. Posting RFC for button payloads after the walkthrough. :calendar:

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Partner SEV play walkthrough" 2025-02-12 11:00 PT. Link: https://meet.redwood.example/psv-848

Rae (SRE): One more: ensure every created incident includes originator IP or workspace id when possible, for audit and security correlation.

Jon (Support Escalations): Agreed. We'll also log the chosen initiation path (button/email/phone/reaction) in the incident record for postmortems.

Eli (Partnerships): Thanks all. If nobody objects I'll push the pin and email template and open the RFC for the payload fields. :+1:
